items.title: 52240_Frank _Machito_ Grillo oral history interview
items.q: the opening was by Artie Shaw and myself.

ctx.x: Uh-Huh, okay. Ahh you also had a place called Cubop City, which that's the name that Symphony Sid gave it. You used to be located above Jack Dempsey's on 51st Street. How did you get to work there?
Well, we were established as a Afro-Cuban jazz orchestra so, as a matter of fact, the opening was by Artie Shaw and myself.
